title: [finding] the `npm create objectstack` blank template's config imports only `./src/objects`, so every `os g view|action|flow|dashboard|app|skill` it scaffolds is never loaded (`os validate` counts 0)
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**, `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/objectstack.config.ts`. Finding class **(c)**: a metadata trap with a named producer, with `reach:` measured.

Found by the `os-dev` round on #20215 (PR #20329). That PR fixes the same trap for `os init`'s templates and adds a loud `os g` "not wired" report, but `packages/create-objectstack` was read-only in its claim. This is the same family as #20215 row 1. Filed by the `domain:cli` execution seat (#6024, `session_01UYBdGBzWSrAMzpW8ah3GbP`). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens (measured by the dev on a replica of that config shape at PR #20329's `cae468f49`, relayed)

- The blank template's `objectstack.config.ts` imports `./src/objects/index.js` alone and declares `requires: ['automation']`.
- `os g view|action|flow|dashboard|app|skill` writes the file and a barrel. With PR #20329 it exits 0 with the new loud "not wired" report, and the config is unchanged.
- `os validate` exits 0 with `0 Flows`: the generated metadata is never loaded.

## Why it matters

`npm create objectstack` is the NORTH-STAR road's own entry. PR #20329 makes the gap loud but does not close it for this starter. The fix is the same shape as PR #20329's `os init` fix: wire every generator barrel. If a flow is ever wired, it also needs `triggers` in `requires`.

## Seam

`producer:packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/objectstack.config.ts` → `cli:os generate` / `os validate` (the stack reach).

## Dedupe

MCP issue search in this repository, run 2026-09-27: 「create-objectstack blank template config imports only src/objects, generated views flows not wired」 → 20 hits.
- #20215 (open) is the parent, and covers `os init` only.
- #5420 (closed) is a hand-written showcase trap.
- The rest are closed and unrelated.

None of them is this defect.

Dedupe words: `create-objectstack blank template barrels not wired` · `npm create objectstack os g view not counted` · `blank starter imports src/objects only`
